items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: When Chad asked me, you know, she didn't... She wouldn't let us stay down there until the weekend.

ctx.x: But he'd pick out the material and send it to you. He'd send the material, and he'd send... He'd send the material, and he'd send... Vancouver, that's what I'm trying to...

Oh, Vancouver. He was up to... He'd send us some things from Vancouver, and my goodness, my grandmother, they were too large for us anyway. He must have thought we were going to be bean balls, like him. But he'd send coats and sweaters, and I mean, little coats here, and weren't supposed to wear the kind of coats he was sending us. Yeah. And sometimes she'd let us go to school with him, and sometimes she wouldn't. Mm-hmm. She said, because when I'm not able to pay that fifty cents a week for you to go to school,…
